sections.title: 共用工具、耗材與選配
sections.title_en: Shared tools, consumables and optional items

items.name: 相機
items.specification: 製作者曾購買 ASIN B0C5W1QF65；不從原 BOM 推定本商品的感光元件或鏡頭規格。
items.validation_note: 製作者提供的購買連結；本次頁面無法讀取，型號、變體、FOV、PCB 厚度與介面待補。
items.specification_en: Previously purchased Amazon Japan ASIN B0C5W1QF65. Do not infer this product's image sensor or lens from the original BOM.
items.validation_note_en: Builder-provided purchase link; page could not be retrieved during review. Record exact model, selected variant, FOV, PCB thickness and interface.

items.name: ★ 既有 CSI → USB 轉接板
items.specification: 沿用現有、與相機配合的 CSI–USB 板；目前找不到相同替代品。
items.validation_note: 本版跳過採購；記錄板卡標示、排線腳位與方向、接線及供電。
items.specification_en: Reuse the existing camera-compatible CSI-to-USB board. A matching replacement has not been found.
items.validation_note_en: Skip procurement in this revision. Record the board markings, cable pinout/orientation, wiring and supply.

items.name: 透明壓克力 camera window
items.specification: 原版板厚 2 mm 僅作參考；最終厚度、外形、公差待量測出圖。
items.validation_note: 製作者指定可找此店發包；未提供已下單規格。只有 window 發包壓克力，其餘模具列印。
items.specification_en: Original design used 2 mm acrylic as a reference. Confirm final thickness, outline and tolerances from the actual shell.
items.validation_note_en: Builder-recommended outsourcing vendor; no completed order specification is recorded. Only this window is acrylic; casting molds are 3D printed.

items.name: 第一層透明矽膠
items.specification: 原 BOM 指透明 9345；日本同等材料未核實。
items.validation_note: 需確認透明度、硬化系統、硬度及層間相容性；不是任意透明型取り材皆可替代。
items.specification_en: Original BOM specifies clear 9345 silicone. A Japan-sourced equivalent has not been confirmed.
items.validation_note_en: Verify clarity, cure chemistry, hardness and interlayer compatibility. A generic clear mold-making silicone is not an approved substitute.

photo.alt_en: Layer 1: two white Huizhou-labelled bottles with QR codes

items.name: 第二層半透明矽膠：Shore 0
items.specification: 已知實作：原淘寶 item 649539121020 選 Shore 0 號（製作者描述為 Shore A 0）；日本替代未驗證。

links.label: 日本 Shore A 0 試作／材料詢問

items.validation_note: 00-30／00-50 不等於 A0；日方頁面有售罄文字。先小樣比較光學、回復及黏合；不可按已驗證替代品下單。 ワイテック列有乳白色 A0 材料／試作，但原料零售與光學適用性未確認。
items.specification_en: Current build uses the Shore 0 option of Taobao item 649539121020, described by the builder as Shore A 0. Japan replacements are unvalidated.
items.validation_note_en: Ecoflex 00-30/00-50 are not equivalent hardness designations to A0; Japanese pages displayed sold-out text. Test optical response, recovery and bonding. Ytech lists milky-white A0 materials/prototyping; raw-material retail and sensor suitability remain unconfirmed.

photo.alt_en: Layer 2: two bottles with blue SHORE A 0 stickers

items.name: 第三層黑色表皮用矽膠
items.specification: 製作者指定的第三層矽膠，使用提供的 Amazon 商品連結。
items.validation_note: 由選購包裝記錄品牌、型號、混合比例與固化條件；不將此配方當作第二層材料。
items.legacy_reference: Silicone to make the black gel layer
items.specification_en: Builder-specified silicone for layer 3, using the supplied Amazon product link.
items.validation_note_en: Record brand/model, mixing ratio and curing conditions from the selected package. This is the third-layer material, not the second-layer silicone.

photo.alt_en: Layer 3: yellow and blue silicone jars

items.name: 黑色矽膠顏料
items.specification: 製作者指定的第三層黑色矽膠顏料，使用提供的 AliExpress 商品連結。
items.validation_note: 記錄實際選購顏色與添加量，以及搭配第三層矽膠的固化和遮光結果。
items.specification_en: Builder-specified black pigment for layer 3, using the supplied AliExpress product link.
items.validation_note_en: Record the selected color and pigment loading, then document cure and light-blocking results with the third-layer silicone.

items.name: M2 熱熔嵌件
items.quantity_basis: 原版參考 8；修改版待核對
items.specification: 原 BOM 標為 M2-5-3；長度／外徑的標示順序未核實。
items.validation_note: 先依尺寸圖及 CAD 確認螺紋、長度、外徑、孔徑與埋深；嵌件不一定是 3.2 mm 外徑通用品。
items.specification_en: Legacy BOM notation: M2-5-3. The order of body-length/outside-diameter dimensions is unverified.
items.validation_note_en: Check thread, body length, OD, hole diameter and insertion depth against the drawing/CAD. Do not assume a generic 3.2 mm OD insert fits.

items.name: 底座／外殼 M2 螺絲
items.quantity_basis: 原版參考 4；修改版待核對
items.specification: 原 BOM M2 × 6 mm；頭型、材質與有效牙長需配合實物。
items.validation_note: 購買機械牙，不是自攻螺絲；檢查頭高、PCB 間隙與是否頂底。
items.legacy_reference: M2 screws for installing the sensor base
items.specification_en: Legacy specification: M2 × 6 mm; head style, material and effective thread engagement need a fit check.
items.validation_note_en: Use machine screws, not self-tapping screws. Check head clearance, PCB clearance and bottoming-out.

items.name: 模具 M3 螺帽
items.quantity_basis: 原版參考 8／套；列印模具待核對
items.specification: M3；依實際 3D 列印模具的夾持設計確認是否沿用。
items.validation_note: 不可把原壓克力模具用量直接視為列印模具用量。
items.legacy_reference: M3 nuts for installing the mold
items.quantity_basis_en: Original reference: 8 per set; printed molds TBC
items.specification_en: M3. Confirm whether the actual printed-mold clamping design reuses them.
items.validation_note_en: The original acrylic mold quantity is not automatically the quantity for a printed mold.

items.name: 模具 M3 螺絲
items.quantity_basis: 原版參考 8／套；列印模具待核對
items.specification: 原 BOM M3 × 30 mm；依列印模具堆疊厚度與夾持方式確認。
items.validation_note: 先核對夾緊長度與孔位；不是已驗證列印模具五金。
items.legacy_reference: M3 screws for installing the mold
items.quantity_basis_en: Original reference: 8 per set; printed molds TBC
items.specification_en: Legacy specification: M3 × 30 mm. Check printed-mold stack thickness and clamping arrangement.
items.validation_note_en: Verify clamping length and hole positions; this is not validated hardware for the missing printed-mold design.

items.name: 電子秤
items.specification: 依最小 A/B 加料量與顏料量選解析度；0.01g 等級可作選型起點，須確認量程與校驗。
items.validation_note: 顯示解析度不等於量測精度。
items.specification_en: Select resolution for the smallest A/B and pigment additions. 0.01 g display resolution is a starting point; verify capacity and calibration.
items.validation_note_en: Display resolution is not measurement accuracy.

items.name: 熱熔膠槍
items.specification: 接線或非光學處暫固定工具；不是 window 或矽膠的指定接著劑。
items.validation_note: 依實際固定位置、耐熱與拆修需求確認是否需要；不把熱熔膠放進光路。
items.specification_en: For temporary non-optical fastening or wiring, if needed. Not the specified adhesive for the window or silicone layers.
items.validation_note_en: Confirm fastening location, temperature and serviceability. Keep hot glue out of the optical path.

items.name: 溫控烙鐵／工具
items.specification: HAKKO FX600-02（日本 100V）；嵌件工具頭與焊接工具需依用途分開選。
items.validation_note: LED 沿用，是否需焊接由現有線路狀態決定。
items.specification_en: HAKKO FX600-02, Japanese 100 V version. Select separate tips/tools for soldering and insert installation as appropriate.
items.validation_note_en: LED assembly is reused; soldering needs depend on its existing wiring.

items.name: 美工刀：脫模界面分離／修邊
items.specification: 第二層半透明與第三層黑色矽膠脫模時，沿模具—矽膠交界小心分離；實際刀具型號待補。
items.validation_note: 此為製作者確認的脫模方式修改；不用手指壓／拉開邊緣，不切進感測接觸面、黑色表皮或 window。
items.name_en: Utility knife: demolding interface release / trimming
items.specification_en: For demolding both layer 2 (translucent) and layer 3 (black): carefully release the mold–silicone interface. Exact knife model still to be recorded.
items.validation_note_en: Builder-confirmed lab procedure: do not press/pull the silicone edge by hand; keep the blade at the interface, away from the sensing surface, black skin and window.

items.name: 混合杯
items.specification: PP 等可相容的乾淨容器，容量需預留脫泡膨脹空間。
items.validation_note: 材質與矽膠的硬化相容性先小樣確認。
items.specification_en: Clean compatible cups, such as suitable PP containers; leave room for expansion during degassing.
items.validation_note_en: Test material/cure compatibility with the selected silicone.

items.name: 攪拌棒
items.specification: 乾淨塑膠攪拌棒，避免未驗證表面處理物污染。
items.validation_note: 依原廠指示充分混合；每種材料工具保持分開。
items.specification_en: Clean plastic mixing tools without unverified surface treatments.
items.validation_note_en: Mix according to the material instructions. Keep tools for different materials separate.

items.name: 除塵／低掉屑清潔耗材
items.specification: 原 BOM 為 Dust removal paper；低掉屑拭紙、除塵貼等功能不同，要依使用位置選。
items.validation_note: 確認不留膠、不刮傷、不帶入硬化抑制物；不把帶膠除塵貼當光學擦拭紙。
items.specification_en: Legacy BOM says dust removal paper. Low-lint wipes and adhesive dust-removal stickers serve different functions.
items.validation_note_en: Check residue, scratching and cure contamination. Do not treat an adhesive sticker as an optical wiping sheet.

items.name: 塑膠針筒
items.specification: 無針、容量依實際注入量；需確認密封件與矽膠相容性。
items.validation_note: 只作施膠／注料用途；確認實際接液材料。
items.specification_en: Needle-free; select capacity for actual dispensing volume and confirm seal compatibility.
items.validation_note_en: For resin/silicone dispensing only; check the actual wetted materials.

items.name: Window 接著劑
items.specification: 透明、適用 PMMA 與現有白色外殼並提供所需密封；選用項目已由製作者確認。
items.validation_note: 記錄實際使用接著劑，避免多餘膠材進入光學面。
items.specification_en: Clear adhesive compatible with PMMA and the existing white shell, providing the required window seal. Selection reviewed by the builder.
items.validation_note_en: Record the adhesive actually used and keep the optical surfaces clear of excess adhesive.

items.name: 黑色層黏合／修補膠
items.specification: Smooth-On Sil-Poxy，限實際需要矽膠接著或修補的位置。
items.validation_note: 不是原黑色層整面塗膠的已驗證配方；避免用較硬膠層改變接觸層力學。
items.specification_en: Smooth-On Sil-Poxy, only where silicone bonding or repair is actually needed.
items.validation_note_en: Not a validated recipe for coating the entire black layer. Avoid altering contact-layer mechanics with a harder adhesive layer.

items.name: 真空脫泡設備
items.specification: 真空泵＋耐真空腔體＋接頭；日本 100V、容積、壓力與混合料膨脹餘量需選型。
items.validation_note: 原淘寶容量選項不是必須照買；記錄實際使用的真空泵、腔體與接頭配置。
items.specification_en: Pump, vacuum-rated chamber and compatible fittings. Confirm Japanese 100 V supply, chamber volume, pressure and expansion headroom.
items.validation_note_en: Legacy Taobao chamber options are not mandatory dimensions. Record the actual lab pump, chamber and fitting combination.

items.name: 固化加熱設備
items.specification: 僅在選用材料允許的硬化／後固化條件下使用；本版實作溫度與時間尚未記錄。
items.validation_note: 不沿用不同材料的加熱配方；原 BOM 亦列為 optional。
items.specification_en: Use only when the chosen material permits the selected cure/post-cure conditions. Actual build temperature/time not recorded.
items.validation_note_en: Do not transfer a heating recipe between different materials. The original BOM also lists this as optional.

items.name: ★ LED 板／既有線路
items.specification: Reuse existing LED assembly. 日本發包暫跳過。
items.validation_note: 不提供一般 LED 環作等效替代；接手需記錄既有零件 ID、接線、方向與供電。
items.specification_en: Reuse existing LED assembly. New fabrication/procurement in Japan is deferred.
items.validation_note_en: Do not substitute a generic LED ring. Record assembly ID, wiring, orientation and supply.

photo.alt_en: Reused green LED board, showing panel and two separate boards

items.name: ★ 白色 sensor shell
items.specification: Reuse existing white shell. **不能用 PLA 列印。** 日本發包暫跳過。
items.validation_note: 材質／製程涉及光學透光與散射；本次未驗證替代品。
items.specification_en: Reuse existing white shell. DO NOT PRINT IN PLA. New fabrication/procurement is deferred.
items.validation_note_en: Transmission and diffusion depend on material/process. No replacement shell is qualified here.

items.name: 修改版底座
items.specification: sensor_base_adapt_for_thick_PCB.STL；另附同名 SolidWorks source。
items.validation_note: STL 已由製作者補齊；STEP、列印材質、切片參數與 PCB 配合尺寸待補。
items.specification_en: sensor_base_adapt_for_thick_PCB.STL, with same-name SolidWorks source supplied separately.
items.validation_note_en: Builder has supplied the STL. STEP export, print material/settings and measured PCB fit still need recording.

items.name: 修改版 camera isolation ring
items.specification: isolation_ring_out_11.4_in_10.3.STL；另附同名 SolidWorks source。
items.validation_note: 檔名不是尺寸驗證；確認 mm 比例、列印設定與實物遮光效果。
items.specification_en: isolation_ring_out_11.4_in_10.3.STL, with same-name SolidWorks source supplied separately.
items.validation_note_en: Filename is not dimensional certification. Check millimetre scale, printing settings and installed light isolation.

items.name: LEAP fingertip 固定件
items.specification: STL chip-holder 版及 SolidWorks 版均保留，不假設兩檔同版。
items.validation_note: 由 LEAP 官方 CAD 修改；原授權條款待核對。固定螺絲、材質及手部行程待量測。
items.specification_en: Both the chip-holder STL and the SolidWorks variant are preserved; they are not assumed to be matching revisions.
items.validation_note_en: Derived from official LEAP CAD; reconcile source license. Check screws, material and hand-motion clearances.

items.name: 3D 列印 casting molds
items.specification: 使用 3D 列印模具，取消原版壓克力 mold 板採購。
items.validation_note: 本版列印檔尚未提供；原上游 DXF 僅幾何參考，需建成實體並確認厚度、密封與脫模。
items.specification_en: Use 3D printed molds; remove the original acrylic mold plates from the purchasing list.
items.validation_note_en: Actual mold files have not been supplied. Upstream DXF is a geometry reference, not a printable solid; confirm thickness, sealing and demolding.

items.name: Calibration board
items.specification: 使用上游 calibration_board 檔案。
items.validation_note: 此 repo 未複製上游檔；新材料或機構變動後應重新校正。
items.specification_en: Use the upstream calibration_board design.
items.validation_note_en: Original file is not bundled. Recalibrate after changing materials or mechanics.

items.name: 線材固定與拉力釋放
items.specification: 小型束帶／適當線材固定件；不是原 BOM 指定品。
items.validation_note: 依實際線徑與關節活動量確認，不夾壓 FPC 或限制關節。
items.quantity_basis_en: As required by actual LEAP routing
items.specification_en: Small cable ties / suitable retainers; an addition to the legacy BOM.
items.validation_note_en: Check cable diameter and full intended joint travel. Do not compress FPC cables or restrict joints.
